Ɓeydu golle ɗiɗi-ɗiɗi, waɗtu ɗum foti fii seeɗa, tee kuutoro bikkon e sifannde (visual) ngam ɓeydude faamugol e heɓtugol hakkille. Momtu ɓe e jawdi: njaaɓndi e jam, njiylawol yahdude, mboddi e leemun, e faamdu no feewi wonde ko hakkunde mo ɓuri no waɗi. Momtu kadi no feewi waɗugo baawɗe ɓenndude e ɓanngel, kadi addi waɗude goonga e mo, tee yaltu sankiraaji. So ɗum ɓuri, walla alaa ɓuri fayde, yah to asibiti ngam warorde ɗaɓɓitde mawnude ko feewi (jiital, kordeji, hakkunde ko ADHD walla waɗɗere sawru) ngam feere e tappugol mawɗo.

model_answer:
Ko waɗi woni “bingel” no feewi e maɓɓe, ɗum ena waawi be hernia (ɓernde tawaama) ngam bangon fello maako ko yahi ko cindi e leydi naatude e gite.  
Ko feewde tawa o walaa diiwa, o walaa ndewru, o walaa hakke kilo, ɗum ena haɗi no ɓuri hernia so tawii ɗum ena yaha kadi so tawii o welti no feewi.  
Hernia ɗo, magani mawɗo ko feddere (surgery), sabu ɗum ena waawi ɓuri tawa so tawii o jipporee.  
Ngam nafoore, reento e waɗde ko feewi: haɗa ɗawtude loowdi kañum, yiɗdu e waɗde haɓɓere no feewi, faggude tuufaare/cough e laawol, tee waɗde ndiyam e laawol ngam constipation.  
So bingel ndiyam ena welti, o ɗo waɗi mballal, walla o waɗi saɓɓe, yah to asibiti kisa.
